items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Old man Bob, Bob, Bob, he was a member. He died in there, you know.

ctx.x: But did you belong to many clubs and societies and stuff?

I belonged to the Greyhound, they used to parade too, Greyhound sports. And the Garden District, they used to give a lot of dances and picnics and different things. And while the young man delivered, I was in there, otherwise they used it. Old man Bob, Bob, Bob, he was a member. He died in there, you know. And I'm in there, thirty-some odd years. Thirty-some odd years. Well, it's a constitutional choir for music, buried with music. But we down now to fifty-six. Fifty-six members. But we got plenty of money. So we…
